description: Use when a contract, a venue or a person wants every Tickerz oracle feed at once, as on https://oracle.tickerz.com: per index the newest signed value and its period, status (signed, recounted, final, corrected or disputed), how often it is signed, whether a market may settle on it and why, how many reads must agree, the rule version and hash, and its feed account on Solana. live says whether the Solana program is written to yet; before it is, read the signed reports (get_report). Read from a stored copy; read_at says when.
name: list_feeds
title: Oracle feeds
